name: lockin-design-system
description: Lock In Design System — tokens, components, specs and an MCP hub for humans and AI agents, on web and mobile.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @stillxp/tokens && npm run build -w @stillxp/icons && npm run build -w @stillxp/specs && npm run build -w @stillxp/react && npm run build -w @stillxp/react-native && npm run build -w @stillxp/storybook && npm run test -w @stillxp/storybook
scripts.check: npm run check:contrast -w @stillxp/tokens && npm run validate -w @stillxp/specs && npm run validate:proposals && npm run check:code -w @stillxp/specs && npm run check:figma -w @stillxp/specs && npm run typecheck -w @stillxp/react && npm run typecheck -w @stillxp/react-native && npm run typecheck -w @stillxp/server && npm run typecheck -w @stillxp/storybook
scripts.test: npm test -w @stillxp/server && npm test -w @stillxp/specs && npm test -w @stillxp/storybook && npm run test:proposals
